answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 entry slots; every applicant bids a sunk 25 POA, and top bids win slots lapsing after 3 idle epochs. The kernel is that a slot is priced, so no identity is free. Honest agents bid once and earn it back, while a Sybil farm faces an ocean of identical bids: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 25 = 25,000 POA sunk. A nebula of fakes pays per identity. One honest identity pays once; a thousand fakes pay a thousand times.
